# Nexuron Technologies
> Nexuron Technologies is a custom software development company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, with a development centre in Kadi, Gujarat, India. We build AI-accelerated web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, and automation solutions for startups and enterprises across North America and globally. Founded with 10+ years of combined team experience, Nexuron has delivered 20+ projects across healthcare, legal tech, martech, travel, fintech, and retail.

## Who We Are
Nexuron Technologies is a full-service software engineering and product development company. We serve startups and mid-sized businesses that need a reliable offshore development partner with clear communication, on-time delivery, and long-term technical accountability. Our team is based across Canada and India, giving clients the advantage of North American business alignment with cost-efficient execution.

**Company type:** Private, B2B technology services company

## What We Build
Nexuron delivers end-to-end software products across four capability areas:

**1. Web Development**
Custom web applications, business portals, SaaS platforms, and e-commerce systems. Technology stack includes MEAN/MERN, Laravel, PHP, ASP.NET Core, WordPress, and React/Angular/Vue.js frontends.

**2. Mobile App Development**
Native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin, Java) apps, plus cross-platform solutions with Flutter and React Native. Covers marketplace apps, booking systems, healthcare tools, and on-demand platforms.

**3. Cloud, DevOps & Automation**
CI/CD pipeline setup, Docker/Kubernetes infrastructure, cloud migrations on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Workflow automation using n8n and Zapier. AI-powered business automation and agentic systems.

**4. AI & Emerging Technology**
Custom AI/ML model development, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, and AI agent engineering. IoT device connectivity, sensor integration, and cloud dashboard development. Python-based data pipelines and production ML systems.

**5. Design**
UI/UX design with user research, wireframing, and interactive prototyping. Graphic design, brand identity, and 3D product visualization for web and mobile products.

## Client Work & Case Studies
Portfolio and project case studies: https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study

### Featured Projects
- **Neonify — AI-Powered Content Marketing Platform** (MarTech, 2026): Built a real-time AI content generation and multi-channel publishing platform for a B2B SaaS marketing company, using Cloudflare infrastructure for performance and reliability. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/neonify-ai-content-platform

- **Rx Incident — Pharmacy Safety Platform** (Healthcare, 2026): Built an anonymous incident reporting and cross-pharmacy learning platform for Canadian independent pharmacies, replacing paper logs and enabling provincial compliance without staff exposure to blame. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/rx-incident-safety-platform

- **Clause Room — Legal Clause Management Platform** (Legal Tech, 2026): Built a centralized contract clause library and approval workflow system for legal teams, eliminating manual clause hunting across email threads and shared drives. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/clause-room-legal-platform

- **AI-Enhanced Lead Management with n8n** (Automation, 2025): Built an n8n-powered automated lead distribution and personalized communication system for a SaaS platform serving tour and travel operators. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/ai-enhanced-lead-management

- **Modernizing Legacy Software with React, .NET & Azure** (Modernization, 2025): Rebuilt a legacy web platform with a React frontend and ASP.NET Core backend on Azure, delivering a secure, fast, and maintainable architecture. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/modernizing-legacy-software

- **Seamless Salon Experience — Mobile App Migration** (Mobile Apps, 2025): Migrated a salon chain's legacy booking app to a real-time mobile system with live waiting list updates and instant notifications, reducing scheduling confusion and missed appointments. https://nexurontechnologies.com/case-study/seamless-salon-experience
